run_nvs_from_unposed_video: run novel view synthesis from an unposed video using the fillerbuster inpainter model
run_camera_pose_prediction: run camera pose prediction from video frames using multidiffusion sampling and camera fitting
run_nerfstudio_export: run export of predicted novel views and camera poses to Nerfstudio transforms.json format
run_ellipsoid_camera_path: run generation of an ellipsoid camera path around predicted camera poses for novel view synthesis
run_viser_visualization: run a viser 3D viewer to visualize predicted and aligned camera frustums in real time
